sentences.text:
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.397 of 2022,
under Sections 376-D, 506 I.P.C. Police Station Gunnour, District- Sambhal with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
According to prosecution version, on 04.11.2022 at around 5.00 AM, while the prosecutrix has gone into the sugarcane field to attend the call of nature, applicant caught her and committed rape upon her and co-accused Rajkumar remained standing there having a tamancha in his hand.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C,
Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17241575/
1 prosecutrix has stated that applicant has committed rape upon her while co-accused Rajkumar,
having a tamancha, was standing at boundary of the ranch but in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, prosecutrix has stated that first applicant has committed rape upon her and thereafter,
co-accused Rajkumar committed rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: She has also introduced one Chandrakesh and stated that said Chandrakesh also committed rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: There are material contradictions in the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It was stated that prosecutrix is a mature lady, aged 28 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further submitted that earlier the applicant has lodged a first information report on 19.10.2022, under section 452, 376, 506, 120B IPC against one Rohit and Mukesh and that said Rohit is nephew of the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It was submitted that first information report of this case has been lodged as a counter blast of the said FIR, by making false and baseless allegations.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further, in statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., prosecutrix has also made allegations of rape against co-accused Rajkumar, who has already been enlarged on bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the copy of which, is available on record.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Lastly, it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 14.01.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail, however, it has not been disputed that similarly placed co-accused Rajkumar has already been granted bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Ravindra vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023.json

2.The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
